_meta.name: SC Boardwalk Crew — hiring template
_meta.note: Blue-band hiring card matching the client's own v1 designs: a solid-blue HEADER band (NOW HIRING + role), a NO-PEOPLE photo in the middle, and a solid-blue FOOTER band with the apply URL + handle. Only the middle photo is AI-generated; all text + bands are drawn in code so the apply URL/handle are always exact and the photo can never invent a fake uniform.

PHOTO_RULES: NO people, faces, hands, or posed crew.
NO uniforms, badges, lanyards, or branded clothing (we don't know the real uniforms).
Show the WORK / SCENE / EQUIPMENT for the role, or a boardwalk / coastal scene.
NO text, words, numbers, logos, or watermarks inside the photo.
